_comment: Values declared in data that no code reads, accepted for now. The data->code check in validate_data.py fails on anything unread that is NOT listed here, so this file is the record of known gaps rather than a way to silence the check. Shrink it by wiring a consumer, never by adding a line without a reason.

base_bonuses stat._reason: Skill payouts with no consumer yet. `_pct` is a percentage, `party_` means one member's skill pays the whole party (best member — see PartyBonuses), a bare name is flat. One remains: crafting_quality_pct waits on the equipment and crafting audit — camp crafting pulls from a fixed CRAFT_TABLE with no quality concept, so there is nothing for it to modify. Written up in TODO. crafting_yield_pct, loot_quality_pct and trap_detection_pct were wired on 2026-09-16 and removed from this list on 09-18, which is a month of the list that catches drift having drifted.

status effect._reason: Behaviour strings on statuses.json entries that no code interprets. Several are one-off mechanics on a single status; `knockback` gains a reader when forced movement lands.
